semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: SPC requires a governed measurement binding.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Map the process measurement explicitly if smart onboarding cannot bind it unambiguously.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Production drift review should use an explicit time field.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind timestamp/event time so control-chart order is auditable and event overlays align correctly.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: SPC is safer when scoped to a reviewed manufacturing population.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Set tool/chamber, product, operation, recipe, or lot context before interpreting control limits.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Excursion defense requires the governed response metric.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind the affected response metric explicitly.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Excursion analysis requires an affected population.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Define the affected population in the shared AnalysisContext.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Excursion analysis requires a control population.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Define the control population in the shared AnalysisContext.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: FDC trace analysis requires trace time.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind the trace timestamp/sample-time field.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: FDC analysis requires sensor values.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind the governed sensor-value field.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: FDC analysis requires sensor identity.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind sensor/parameter identity explicitly.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Tool-health interpretation should be scoped to a tool or chamber.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Choose tool/chamber context before comparing traces or fingerprints.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Wafer exploration requires wafer identity.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind wafer_id or the equivalent governed entity field.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Spatial wafer analysis requires x coordinates.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind die/wafer x coordinates.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Spatial wafer analysis requires y coordinates.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind die/wafer y coordinates.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Lot-wafer comparison is safer when a lot is selected.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Set lot context before comparing wafers unless the workflow intentionally spans lots.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Yield loss requires a governed loss/bin category.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind bin, yield-bin, category, or reviewed defect-class field.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Yield loss requires a loss/count value.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind the governed loss/count measurement.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Yield decomposition should normally be scoped to product/technology context.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Set product or equivalent manufacturing context before comparing loss contributors.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: PM-effect analysis requires a response metric.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind the reviewed process/equipment response metric.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: PM-effect analysis requires a post-PM/affected population.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Define the affected population in shared AnalysisContext.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: PM-effect analysis requires a comparison/control population.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Define the pre-PM/control population in shared AnalysisContext.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Chamber matching requires the comparison feature.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind the governed chamber-comparison feature.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Chamber matching requires chamber identity.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Bind the chamber entity field.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: Chamber matching is safer within reviewed tool/recipe context.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Set tool and recipe context before interpreting chamber deltas.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: RCA requires an affected population.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Define the affected population before ranking commonality.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: RCA requires a control population.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Define a defensible control population before interpreting enrichment/commonality.

semiconductor_operational_guardrails.message: RCA should record a reviewed process scope.
semiconductor_operational_guardrails.remediation: Set operation/route/product or equivalent context to prevent accidental cross-process comparisons.
